items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer lists Arnold Ross in a note; the interviewee does not mention him or claim any personal interaction.

ctx.x: And who else was in that small group besides Willie?
(Dick Cathcart, Babe Russin, Arnold Ross, Irving Ashby, E. Mihelich, Nick Fatool -- ed.)
The trumpet player was a white fellow; I don't know his name -- I forgot.
